name: Inshallah
arabic: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).

metadata.reference: Ebu Davudi 2/306 dhe të tjerë. “Sahih el-Xhamiu” 4/209.

transliterations.latin: Dhehebe edh-dhameu, veb-tel-letil-uruku ve thebetel-exhru inshaAll-llah

translations.albanian: Kaloi etja, u lagën venat dhe u realizua shpërblimi inshAllah.
translations.english: (The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.)
translations.indonesian: Maha Suci Allah yang halilintar bertasbih dengan memujiNya, begitu juga para malaikat, karena takut kepadaNya." 189 Doa Meminta Hujan dam Menghentikan Hujan
